queries.sql: SELECT DISTINCT *, "" as `ctt_principal`, `leadsstatus`.`color`, `leadsstatus`.`id_list`, `leadsstatus`.`name` as `statusname`, `staff`.`staffname` as `leadassigned`, `staff`.`staffavatar` as `assignedavatar`, `leadssources`.`name` as `sourcename`, `leads`.`name` as `leadname`, `leads`.`email` as `leadmail`, `leads`.`phone` as `leadphone`, `leads`.`id` as `id`, `leads`.`status` as `status_f`, IF(leads.name != "", `leads`.`name`, leads.company) as name_lead, `leads`.`lost` FROM `leads` INNER JOIN `leadsstatus` ON `leads`.`status` = `leadsstatus`.`id` LEFT JOIN `leadssources` ON `leads`.`source` = `leadssources`.`id` INNER JOIN `staff` ON `leads`.`assigned_id` = `staff`.`id` WHERE `staff`.`id_company` = '1' AND `leadsstatus`.`id_list` = '65' AND (`leads`.`lost` IS NULL OR `leads`.`lost` = '0') AND `leads`.`dateconverted` IS NULL ORDER BY `name_lead` ASC
